# Pull Request

## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and link the task.

## Evidence

List the exact tests and builds run, including platform-specific results.

## Security and privacy

Describe new permissions, network access, credentials, file mutations, or state migrations. Write `None` when applicable.

## Documentation

List updated documentation and ADRs, or explain why none were needed.

## Remaining limitations

State anything not verified. Do not omit known platform, data-quality, or release limitations.
